plugins.name: shipwright
plugins.description: Design -> adversarial review -> breakdown -> implement -> ship pipeline for Claude Code, with Jira sync, an enforced approval gate, a quality gate, budget protection and a live dashboard.

skills.name: breakdown
skills.description: Decompose a hardened SDD into at most 8 atomic, dependency-ordered tasks, create them as Claude Code tasks and (optionally) Jira subtasks, and write task_state.json. Refuses SDDs that have not been through /shipwright:design hardening. Use after an SDD is approved as a design.
headings: Step 1 — Gate: is this SDD ready?
Step 2 — Read SDD + Jira config (in parallel)
Step 8 — Jira comment on the parent (if enabled)
skills.description_zh: 在 SDD 经 /shipwright:design 加固并获批后，将其拆为最多八个按依赖排序的原子任务，创建 Claude Code 任务、可选 Jira 子任务，并写入 task_state.json。未完成设计加固的 SDD 会被拒绝。

skills.name: checkpoint
skills.description: Show, write, or clear shipwright's resume checkpoint, or clear the current plan. Use when the user asks to save progress, discard an interrupted session, or abandon the current task plan.
skills.description_zh: 查看、写入或清除 Shipwright 恢复检查点，也可清除当前计划。适用于保存进度、丢弃被中断会话或放弃任务计划。

skills.name: dashboard
skills.description: Open the read-only shipwright pipeline dashboard (risks, tasks, amendments, budget, patterns, inbox) and call out anything that needs action. Use when the user asks for status, the dashboard, or an overview of the pipeline.
skills.description_zh: 打开 Shipwright 只读流程仪表盘，查看风险、任务、修订、预算、模式和收件箱，并指出需采取行动的事项。适用于进度或流程概览。

skills.name: design
skills.description: Generate a System Design Document (SDD) from a requirement or Jira ticket, then harden it with fresh-context adversarial review across 10 failure classes until it converges. Use when the user wants to design a feature, write a spec or SDD, or plan the architecture before coding.
skills.description_zh: 依据需求或 Jira 工单生成系统设计文档，再用独立上下文针对十类失败风险进行对抗审核并迭代至收敛。

skills.name: doctor
skills.description: Diagnose a shipwright installation — Python version, framework.json, whether the configured test/lint/typecheck/build commands actually run, Jira config, statusline wiring, and legacy hook wiring. Use when something in the pipeline seems not to fire, or after setup.
skills.description_zh: 诊断 Shipwright 安装，检查 Python 版本、framework.json、测试/lint/类型检查/构建命令是否实际可运行，以及 Jira、状态栏和旧版 hook 配置。适用于流程不触发或安装后检查。

skills.name: init
skills.description: Set up shipwright in the current project in one step — detects the stack, writes .claude/framework.json and state files, wires the budget statusline, seeds CLAUDE.md, optionally commits team settings so every teammate gets the plugin, and migrates legacy copy-installed hooks. Use when the user wants to install, set up, onboard, or migrate shipwright.
headings: Step 2 — Fill the gaps that can't be detected
skills.description_zh: 在当前项目设置 Shipwright，识别技术栈，写入 .claude/framework.json 及状态文件、连接预算状态栏、初始化 CLAUDE.md，可选提交团队设置并迁移旧版复制安装的 hook。适用于安装、初始配置、团队接入或迁移。

skills.name: remember
skills.description: Save a durable project learning — a decision, a correction, an anti-pattern, or a convention — as a memory that shipwright re-injects at session start and design time. Use when the user says remember this, or when a pattern alert or staged style correction needs to be written down.
skills.description_zh: 将项目决策、更正、反模式或约定保存为持久记忆，由 Shipwright 在会话开始和设计阶段重新注入。适用于用户要求记住信息，或需记录模式告警及已暂存的风格更正。

skills.name: resume
skills.description: Continue interrupted shipwright work from .claude/checkpoint.json — reports where it stopped, checks the budget window has reset, and picks up the literal next action. Use when the user says resume, continue, or pick up where we left off.
skills.description_zh: 从 .claude/checkpoint.json 恢复被中断的 Shipwright 工作，报告停止位置、确认预算窗口已重置，并执行记录的下一步。

skills.name: retro
skills.description: Structured feature retrospective once implementation finishes — diffs plan vs. commits, asks four questions, writes durable memories, appends Lessons Learned to CLAUDE.md, flags stale memories, and comments (never transitions) on Jira. Use when the user wants a retro or when all shipwright tasks are complete.
headings: Step 2 — Four questions, one at a time
Step 6 — Jira comment (if enabled; never a transition)
skills.description_zh: 在功能实现结束后开展结构化复盘，对照计划与提交、提出四个问题、写入持久记忆、向 CLAUDE.md 追加经验、标记过期记忆，并仅评论 Jira 而不变更状态。适用于用户复盘或全部任务完成。

skills.name: review
skills.description: Guide a staff/lead engineer through a hardened SDD section by section instead of dumping the whole document — orientation, then Risk Register by severity, adversary pass history, amendments, and test coverage — ending in an explicit verdict. Use when someone who did not write the SDD wants to review it, or asks "what needs my review" / "walk me through this design".
headings: Step 3 — Walk the sections, in this order, one at a time
Step 5 — Jira comment (if enabled; never a transition)
skills.description_zh: 逐节引导未参与编写的高级工程师审核系统设计文档，检查风险等级、对抗审核历史、修订与测试覆盖，形成明确判断。

skills.name: sdd-implementer
skills.description: Implement an approved shipwright plan task by task from its SDD, staying in the implement-bug-fix loop without process interruptions while silently staging design amendments and checkpointing. Use when the user says to implement, build, or continue a feature that has an SDD and an approved task list in .claude/task_state.json.
skills.description_zh: 依据 SDD 和已批准的 .claude/task_state.json 逐项实现 Shipwright 计划，在实现和缺陷修复循环中保持推进，同时暂存设计修订并记录检查点。适用于已具备设计和任务清单的功能构建或继续实施。

skills.name: ship
skills.description: Gated deploy pipeline — documentation, tests, type check, independent code review, build — then Jira transitions and Slack notification. Only run when the user explicitly asks to ship or deploy.
skills.description_zh: 在用户明确要求发布或部署后，按文档、测试、类型检查、独立代码审核和构建门禁执行，再更新 Jira 状态并发送 Slack 通知。

headings: Roll it out to a team
